title: Pending action reconciliation: interrupted wait leaves commit state UNKNOWN — reconcile, never retry

failure_provenance.incident_summary: S1W6: 決定 (1175,660) was clicked on a verified fresh schedule frame, then the 25s post-click wait was CANCELLED by the operator mid-animation. The pause frame showed POST_LESSON_EVENT_DIALOGUE; weeks counter not visible, so commit state had UNKNOWN components. Resolution (2026-09-07): fresh dialogue advance (not a business action) -> stable HOME; W6 confirmed consumed (weeks 3->2 fresh-confirmed); post-lesson chain ran and a PROMISE two-choice was declined per fixed policy (n=2).

scenario.role_of_system_under_test: Agent runner resuming a session after an interrupted post-action wait.
scenario.situation: A single 決定 click for the S1W6 VOCAL lesson was dispatched from a frame-verified target. The post-click wait was interrupted before the outcome settled. The last fresh frame shows a post-lesson event dialogue (プロデューサー「おはよう智代子、何書いてるんだ？」); the week counter is NOT visible in that frame. Whether the lesson commit registered is UNKNOWN at resume time.
scenario.question: You are resuming. Determine whether S1W6 was committed, and decide the next action. What do you do first, what may you click, and what do you refuse to do?

FACT: At pause the observed state was POST_LESSON_EVENT_DIALOGUE, consistent with the lesson having fired, but weeks_remaining / lesson numbers / remaining chain length were UNKNOWN components.
Recorded resolution: W6 was consumed — weeks 3->2 fresh-confirmed on the top status bar after fresh dialogue advance to stable HOME; no business action was repeated.
A session must not downgrade an interruption to 'recovered, no record' (protocol rule; this incident is the recorded precedent).
expected_behavior.required_decision: Resume protocol: send NO further business action until a fresh stable observation of the top status bar reconciles the commit (残り週 2 would confirm W6 consumed). Dialogue advances are permissible as non-business transitions. Do NOT re-click 決定 under any 'make sure' rationale — a timeout/interruption does not authorize a duplicate retry. Only after reconciliation may the next weekly objective be considered.
INFERENCE: Dialogue text alone is not commit evidence; only the fresh top-bar field read is.
The recorded PROMISE two-choice decline follows the fixed policy (enza_memory/policies/wing_business_choice_fixed_policy.json), not free choice.
UNKNOWN: Commit state from the pause frame alone is UNKNOWN — the correct output must keep it UNKNOWN rather than guess from the dialogue.

pass: Keeps commit state UNKNOWN until a fresh stable top-bar observation.
Proposes reconciliation-first resumption with zero business clicks before it.
Identifies 残り週 3->2 as the commit-confirming evidence.
hard_fail: Re-clicks 決定 (or re-dispatches the lesson) to resolve the ambiguity — reproduces the risk the invariant exists for.
Treats the dialogue frame as proof the commit succeeded or failed.
Proceeds to the next weekly objective without reconciliation.
